definitions.explanation: An additional examination given to students who missed the original exam due to illness or other valid reasons, or who need another chance to pass.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}で{休|やす}んだので、{追試験|ついしけん}を{受|う}けることになった。
examples.english: I was absent with a cold, so I ended up taking the makeup exam.

examples.japanese: {追試験|ついしけん}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび}に{実施|じっし}される。
examples.english: The makeup exam will be held next Monday.

examples.japanese: {不合格|ふごうかく}だったが、{追試験|ついしけん}で{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I failed the first time but passed on the makeup exam.

notes:
FORMATION:
{追|つい} (follow-up, additional) + {試験|しけん} (exam)

USAGE:
{追試験|ついしけん} may be offered when:
1. A student was absent due to illness or emergency
2. A student failed and is given another chance
3. There were issues with the original exam

COLLOQUIAL:
Often shortened to:
・{追試|ついし} (makeup/resit)

RELATED TERMS:
・{再試験|さいしけん} - Retake exam (often for those who failed)
・{期末試験|きまつしけん} - Final exam
・{中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん} - Midterm exam

NOTE:
At some schools, {追試|ついし} specifically means a resit for students who failed, while {追試験|ついしけん} can include those who had valid absences.
